feature: LMS.NotificationWorker — Phase 1 service #9: stateless event-driven email worker (MailKit SMTP, Scriban templates, Redis idempotency).

tasks.title: Extend ContentProcessingCompleted / Failed with UploadedBy (additive)
tasks.spec: Per contracts.md section 9. Add `Guid UploadedBy` after `Guid TenantId` in both `LMS.Contracts/Content/ContentProcessingCompleted.cs` and `LMS.Contracts/Content/ContentProcessingFailed.cs`. Update `docs/events.md` records to match. No other event records change. NotificationWorker is the only consumer needing the field, but ContentService.Worker (publisher, currently not yet shipped) must also pass UploadedBy when implemented — leave a TODO comment near the records calling that out. Run a build of LMS.Contracts and any project that already references these records (none currently).

tasks.title: Scaffold LMS.NotificationWorker project
tasks.spec: Create `src/services/LMS.NotificationWorker/` as a single-project worker (NOT the 4-project layout — no DB, no API). `dotnet new worker -n LMS.NotificationWorker`. Add to LMS.slnx. ProjectReferences: LMS.ServiceDefaults, LMS.Contracts, LMS.SharedKernel. NuGet: MassTransit, MassTransit.RabbitMQ, MailKit, Scriban, Aspire.StackExchange.Redis, Microsoft.FeatureManagement, Polly. TreatWarningsAsErrors. Empty Program.cs uses `Host.CreateApplicationBuilder` + `AddServiceDefaults` + MassTransit + Redis + FeatureManagement registration only — consumers come in T6. Create folder structure per contracts.md section 1 (empty `.gitkeep` placeholders OK). appsettings.json + appsettings.Development.json with sections per contracts.md section 4.

tasks.title: Email + Templating + Idempotency primitives
tasks.spec: Implement contracts.md section 3 + 4 primitives. (1) `Email/IEmailSender.cs` + `EmailMessage.cs` + `EmailSendResult.cs` records. (2) `Email/SmtpEmailSender.cs` using MailKit SmtpClient, STARTTLS gated by SmtpOptions.UseStartTls, Polly retry 3x exp 1/3/9s on SmtpProtocolException + IOException, returns EmailSendResult. (3) `Templates/ITemplateRenderer.cs` + `Templates/ScribanTemplateRenderer.cs` resolves `{templateId}.{lang}.{subject|html|text}.sbn` from EmbeddedResource manifest, fallback chain `{lang}->en->throw`. (4) `Idempotency/IIdempotencyStore.cs` + `Idempotency/RedisIdempotencyStore.cs` exposing `Task<bool> TryClaimAsync(string key, TimeSpan ttl, CancellationToken)` using `IDatabase.StringSetAsync(key, '1', ttl, When.NotExists)`. (5) `Options/SmtpOptions.cs` + `Options/NotificationOptions.cs` with `IValidateOptions` validators. (6) `Email/IUserContactCache.cs` + `Email/RedisUserContactCache.cs` storing JSON `{Email,DisplayName,Language}` with sliding 90d TTL. NO consumers in this task.

tasks.title: Scriban template files + per-template view models
tasks.spec: Author 11 template trios (subject/html/text Scriban files) under `Templates/Sbn/en/` for templateIds: user-registered, user-deactivated, course-published, course-archived, user-enrolled, enrollment-cancelled, course-completed, content-ready, content-failed, assessment-submitted, certificate-issued. Each with corresponding `Templates/Models/{TemplateId}Model.cs` immutable record. All `.sbn` files declared as `<EmbeddedResource>` in csproj. HTML templates wrap text in a minimal table layout; text templates plain text. Use `{{ user.email }}` style; rely on Scriban auto-encoding (no `| html.raw`). Subject lines kept short and ASCII. CTAs use `{{ frontend_base_url }}` placeholder fed from NotificationOptions.

tasks.title: AppHost wiring: notifications worker + MailHog container + redis ref
tasks.spec: Edit src/LMS.AppHost/Program.cs per contracts.md section 5. Add MailHog container resource (`mailhog/mailhog:v1.0.1`) with named endpoints `ui` (8025) and `smtp` (1025 tcp). Add `LMS_NotificationWorker` project block with `WithReference(rabbitmq)`, `WithReference(redis)`, `WithEnvironment Smtp__Host` from mail smtp endpoint, `WithEnvironment Smtp__Port=1025`, `WaitFor(rabbitmq)`, `WaitFor(redis)`, `WaitFor(mail)`. Aspire resource name MUST be `notifications` (matches docs/architecture.md). NO gateway changes — worker has no HTTP. Build succeeds.

tasks.title: Implement 12 MassTransit consumers + Program.cs DI wiring
tasks.spec: Per contracts.md section 2. Implement one IConsumer<T> per row in Consumers/ folder. Common base class `NotificationConsumerBase<TEvent>` provides: (a) idempotency claim via IIdempotencyStore using `notif:dedupe:{ConsumerType}:{key}` (key = EventId if present else MessageContext.MessageId), (b) recipient resolution via IUserContactCache (cache miss → log + drop + increment notifications.dropped{reason=cache-miss}), (c) template render via ITemplateRenderer with model factory delegate, (d) IEmailSender.SendAsync, (e) metrics emission. UserRegisteredConsumer is special — it WRITES to IUserContactCache before/after sending welcome email. LessonCompletedConsumer is gated by FeatureFlag `Notifications.LessonProgressEmail` (default false → drop with reason=disabled). CourseArchivedConsumer Phase 1 sends ONLY to instructor (no fan-out). ContentProcessing consumers use new UploadedBy field from T1. Wire all consumers via `x.AddConsumers(Assembly.GetExecutingAssembly())` in Program.cs along with MassTransit retry config (`Immediate(3); Interval(3, 30s)`), Redis registration via `builder.AddRedisClient("redis")`, options validation, OTEL meter `LMS.NotificationWorker`.

tasks.title: Unit tests for primitives + per-template fixtures
tasks.spec: Create new test project `tests/LMS.NotificationWorker.UnitTests/`. Add to LMS.slnx. References LMS.NotificationWorker. Tests per contracts.md section 7 unit list: ScribanTemplateRenderer auto-encoding test (passes `<script>` in input, asserts encoded in HTML output); language fallback test; RedisIdempotencyStore TryClaim NX semantics (use Testcontainers Redis or StackExchange.Redis Memory fake); per-template render smoke (one xunit Theory case per templateId, asserts subject + body non-empty + contains key field).

tasks.title: Integration tests with RabbitMQ + Redis + MailHog + harness
tasks.spec: Add `tests/LMS.IntegrationTests/NotificationWorker/` per contracts.md section 7. Use Testcontainers for RabbitMQ + Redis + MailHog (mailhog/mailhog:v1.0.1, expose 8025 for API, 1025 for SMTP). MassTransit InMemoryHarness wraps the worker host. Cover: (a) one-shot send for each of the 12 events except LessonCompleted (= no-send); (b) idempotency: re-publish same message → only one mail in MailHog; (c) UserRegistered populates contact cache → subsequent UserEnrolled for same (TenantId,UserId) finds cached email; (d) cache-miss path: publish UserEnrolled for unknown user → no mail, metric dropped++; (e) tenant tag propagation: two events for distinct TenantIds → assert MailHog has two mails AND OTEL test exporter has matching tenant_id tags; (f) LessonCompleted with feature flag false → no send; with flag true → send. Use MailHog HTTP API (`GET /api/v2/messages`) for assertions. ArchitectureTests in `tests/LMS.ArchitectureTests/`: NotificationWorker doesn't reference EF Core; doesn't reference any other LMS.*Service.* project; no HttpClient with BaseAddress targeting LMS service. ContractTests: regression test that compiles a hard-coded list of consumed events matching docs/events.md routing table.

tasks.title: Tenant + PII audit on worker
tasks.spec: Run /audit-tenant scoped to src/services/LMS.NotificationWorker. Specific checks: (a) every consumer reads TenantId from the message and stamps it on logs/metrics; (b) idempotency keys include TenantId OR EventId (which is globally unique) — no cross-tenant collisions possible; (c) UserContactCache keys include TenantId prefix; (d) Scriban templates auto-encode user input (test `<script>` injection); (e) no JWT / authorization header parsing exists in worker; (f) no HttpClient with BaseAddress to other LMS services; (g) SmtpOptions password / SmtpOptions credentials never logged (check ILogger usages); (h) MailHog only used in Development environment — production must not emit to it. Produce findings; T11 reviewer must address any HIGH severity items before merge.

tasks.title: Final review against contracts.md + absolute rules
tasks.spec: Run /code-reviewer on T1–T9 changes. Mandatory: (1) NotificationWorker has NO DbContext / EF Core dep; (2) NO new event records added beyond T1's additive UploadedBy; (3) NO direct HTTP between services (no HttpClient targeting LMS); (4) MailKit used (not SendGrid SDK directly Phase 1); (5) all 12 consumer classes exist and are registered; (6) idempotency wired on every consumer; (7) Aspire resource name 'notifications' matches docs/architecture.md; (8) feature flag 'Notifications.LessonProgressEmail' default false; (9) every email log entry includes TenantId; (10) no JWT validation in worker. Address all HIGH-severity findings from T9. Block merge on contract drift.
